_comment: Optional. Copy to config/proof_points.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR OWN facts. Each proof point belongs to one bullet of config/resume.json (its id) and gives the project, what you did, your role (owned, led, built, contributed or used), the technologies, and where the numbers can be shown (evidence: a link, a document, or 'can show in an interview'). A number or a metric without evidence is refused: no evidence, no number. Tailoring v2 may use these facts in a cover letter and in a rewrite of THAT bullet; it never invents any. Check the file with: scripts/jobsearch validate

proof_points.what: Replaced a per-request lookup with a two-level cache and added invalidation on writes.
proof_points.evidence: dashboard screenshot and the pull request, can show in an interview
